text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: He's absorbed the children's spirits to become a monster...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 子どもたちの霊魂を取り込んであんな姿に……！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Hana... The kids...
I've got to save them...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハナちゃんを……
みんなを……
助けてあげないと……！！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Then let's all work together!
You'd better help too, mister!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなで力を合わせようよ！
にいちゃんも力を貸して！
